messages:
Meera: quick design review please — pushed a small tweak to the canary list + new undo modal in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234 (see frames 'Canary Sort v2' and 'Undo modal') Alex: skimmed — main thing: sort order. currently it's chronological (newest first) but that buries active canaries. propose: Active canaries (running, adjustable) first, then recent completed rollouts grouped by day. this reduces scroll when you want to change a live canary. :point_up: Sasha: a11y nits: slider handles need keyboard focus and aria-valuenow. also the list reordering must not surprise screen readers — use aria-live="polite" on the list container when the order changes. small code idea: ```html
  • Canary 72 — 15% — running
``` Jon: microcopy: on the big action we currently say 'Promote'. lei's confusing for non-SEO folks. suggest 'Promote to stable' and for rollback 'Revert to previous version' (clearer). Also the undo toast should include the version id: 'Undo — reverted to v12'. Pat: undo flow: agree with toast. Also recommend we keep an implicit 30s undo window (toast + action id) and then show a short changelog entry in the history with an 'undo' affordance for 2 minutes (only for last action). We should show a small animation when undo is available, but keep reduced-motion preference in mind. Sasha: +1 on reduced-motion. Also color contrast: the active canary badge (yellow on white) fails 3:1; bump to a darker amber or add a 1px outline. screen readers need a non-color indicator too (ex: '(active)') appended visually-hidden. Alex: UX question: sorting controls — do we expose a user toggle 'Sort by: Active / Recent' or auto-sort based on presence of active canaries? My vote: auto-sort + a small 'Sort' chevron for power users. that keeps the default simple. Meera: sounds good. decision so far: auto-sort (Active first) + 'Sort' override in header, microcopy updates (Promote -> 'Promote to stable', Rollback -> 'Revert to previous version'), 30s toast undo + 2m ephemeral history undo, aria-live polite for order changes, keyboardable sliders, reduced-motion respect, contrast fix. Jon: one more: confirmation modal copy — include estimated traffic impact and a single-line explanation like 'Promoting will route X% to this version; users currently on Y% may see different behavior.' keeps support questions down. Meera: good call. I'll update Figma and add those copy strings. Alex, can you pick a darker amber and add the visual-hidden '(active)' node? Sasha, can you run a quick screen-reader pass once updated? Pat will spec the undo timing. I'll post updated frames when done. Thanks all. :raised_hands: deploy-bot: Note: canary-update-1767504 created by Meera at 2026-03-12T15:45:21Z (automated changelog entry).
